(ja)༄༅/ /khro bo'i rgyal po sme ba brtsegs pa sa lugs kyi sgrub thabs las tshogs rjes gnang dang bcas pa bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'a

tei:div.tei:p: (ja)༄༅// khro bo'i rgyal po sme ba brtsegs pa sa lugs kyi sgrub thabs las tshogs rjes gnang dang bcas pa bzhugs so// ༄༅// bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// khro bo sme ba brtsegs pa bsgom par 'dod pas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bya/ de nas snying gar hūm̐ mthing nag cig bsam/ de'i 'od kyis lus bsregs skyon thams cad dag rang khro bo sme ba brtsegs par bsams la/ de yang sku mdog dud kha zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ g.yas zhal dkar ba/ g.yon zhal dmar ba/ dbus zhal dud kha zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum bgrad pa/ mche ba gtsigs shing khro gnyer bsdus pa/ sma ra dang smin ma dmar ser 'bar ba/ dbu skra kham pa gyen du brdzes pa/ sbrul sngon po lto ser gyis dkris shing*/ thod pa skam po lnga lngas dbur brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas dang pos rdo rje rgya gram/ gnyis pas rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ gsum pas rdo rje lcags kyu/ g.yon dang pos rdo rje'i dbyug pa/ gnyis pas rdo rje'i zhags pa/ tha mas rdo rje sdigs mdzub mdzad pa ste/ de thams cad kyang gyen du bsgrengs pa thod pa skam po'i phreng bas se ral khar brgyan pa/ yan lag thams cad sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs can/ zhabs gnyis bgrad pa/ nyi ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ sku las ye shes kyi me 'bar bar bskyed la/ sku de la dmigs pa gtad/ sngags 'di bzla'o// oṃ bhūrkuṃ ma hā prā ṇā ya bhur tsi bhur ki bi mā na se/ u tsuṣma kro dha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ ces bzlas pas bgegs dang log 'dren gyi gnod pa dang*/ nyams grib la sogs pa gang gis kyang mi tshugs shing shin tu gtsang sbra chung bas kyang 'grub par 'gyur ro// 'di la bsnyen pa dang sgrub pa mi dgos/ sems can la phan 'dogs par 'dod na/ 'phral du byas pas phan par 'gyur ro// smyo 'bog can 'dul bar 'dod na/ gu gul nag po sreg cing*/ nad pa'i snying gar sngags brgya rtsa brgyad btab nas/

gdon bgegs thams cad chom gyis bsregs par bsam mo// des nges par phan no// ser ba zlog na sdigs mdzub sprin la gtad de sngags bzlas shing sngags kyi 'od zer me lta bus bsregs par bsams nas/ ser ba chad/ 'brug kha chings/ glog lce chad/ thog gyen la bzlog sprin gyi gur bshig ser ba'i rkang chag go /rims nad gso na/ bum pa spos chus bkang la/ yungs kar la sngags mang du bzlas la bum par blug nad pa la gu gul gyi dud pas bdug cing*/ bum chus lus bkru zhing khong du'ang blud/ des nges par phan no// phyugs god srung na/ dug sna gsum la yor gyi gzugs byas la/ de la yor btang ba dgug gzhug byas la/ phur pa snying gar btab sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas so// phyugs nad byung nas byed na/ rwa ba'i dbus su maṇḍal lam khri byas la de'i steng du/ spos chu la sngags btab nas gtor na phan no// mi glo nad can gso na/

lo nad zer ba 'dug shog bu la nad pa'i ming bris la/ nad pa'i mal 'og tu bcug nas/ nad pa la dmigs pa gtad de sngags mang du btab na phan no// ra lug la spyang ki srung na/ ra lug don pho khyu phud lta bu'i ming yin/ don mo'i mgul du sngags bris la gdags so// 'bras dang*/ phol dang*/ lhog pa rnams gso na nad pa'i sngas su gu gul sreg cing sngags drag tu btab bo// nad pa'i sngas srung byed na mgar gyi sol mal gyi tshwa tshwa la sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas la brab bo// zhing 'bus za na/ tshwa dang yungs kar bsres la sngags brgya rtsa brgyad btab la/ zhing gi mtha' mar bskor nas rlung phyogs nas sngags brgya rtsa brgyad btab na gzhan du bros so// bang mdzod du 'gong po zhugs nas sris la gnod na tsandan nam shug pa dkar po'i phur pa sor bcu gnyis pa la sngags brgya rtsa brgyad btab nas dar gyi cod pan bcings te khro bo sme brtsegs su bskyed nas thod pa mtshan ldan 'bru nag pos bkang ba la btsugs nas bang mdzod du sbas na gnod mi nus shing sris sme'o// 'gong po sreg na tsher ma can gyi shing la me sbar la/ me de skad cig gis khro bo sme brtsegs su bskyed nas/ de'i zhal du bgegs kyi liṅga btab la dbul zhing sngags sum brgya bzla zhing bsregs na phyin chad gnod pa mi nus so// tshar ba dang lha rang la bstim mo// las tshogs 'di rnams la bsnyen pa mi dgos 'phral du byas pa nyid kyis phan no// khro bo sme brtsegs kyi sgrub thabs/ dpal ldan sa skya pa'i man ngag shākya'i dge slong kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis sbyar ba'o// sarba dā maṅga laṃ// ༈ /khro bo'i rgyal po sme ba brtsegs pa sa lugs su grags pa dud kha'i mngon rtogs rjes gnang khrus chog dang bcas pa gsal bar bkod pa'i yi ge mthong ba don ldan bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti/ sku bzhi'i bdag nyid dpal ldan bla ma dang*// dbyer med khro bo 'chol par gus btud nas// gang de'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang cho gar bcas// dang po'i las can don du bshad kyis nyon// 'dir rje btsun sa skya paṇḍi ta nas brgyud pa'i khro bo sme brtsegs dud kha'i rjes gnang bkru byabs dang bcas pa bya ba'i tshul la/

sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po ni stegs bu gru bzhi pa'am/ lcog rtse sogs kyi steng du rdul tshon ras bris gang yang rung ba'i padma 'dab brgyad mdzes tshon du bris pa'i khar mañdzi'i steng bum pa kha rgyan mgul chings dang bcas pa/ chu gtsang mas sum gnyis bkang ba'i steng du dung chos dri bzang gi chus gang ba rdo rje me tog gi phreng ba btags pa bcas bsham/ de'i mdun du gtor ma zlum po theb kyus bskor ba gsum/ chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga bkod pa ci mdzes su bsgrig rjes gnang rkyang pa las mi byed na des chog kyang*/ bkru byabs byed na slob ma du yod kyi grangs dang mthun pa'i bal skud nag po sum bsgril la/ rdo rje'i mdun pa btab pa bzhi re/ theb kyu dang changs bu nyer gcig re/ sbyong chas/ glud gcig dang bcas pa/ slob dpon gyi mdun du rdo rje dril bu/ me tog gi snod dang bcas pa mthong brgyud kyi phyag len ltar bsham mo// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ bdag mdun sgrub pa slob ma'i bya ba'o// dang po ni/ stan bde ba la 'dug ste thog mar mchod pa rnams/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dngas shing thog pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ zhes dang so so'i phyag rgya bcas/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du/ shabda āḥhūm̐ gi bar/ oṃ badzra dharmā ra ṇi ta sogs rol mo dang bcas pas byin gyis brlab/ bdag dang 'gro ba sogs lan bdun la sogs pa brjod/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du khro bo sme ba brtsegs pa'i sgom bzlas zab mo nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum gyis sems bskyed/

oṃ swa bhā wa nas shuddho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi snying gar hūm̐ mthing nag las 'od zer 'phros nad gdon sdig sgrib la sogs pa'i nyes skyon thams cad bsal/ 'od zer gyis lus bsregs sems khro bo sme brtsegs su gyur pa ni/ sku mdog dud kha zhal gsum phyag drug zhal g.yas dkar g.yon dmar/ rtsa zhal dud kha zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ mche ba bzhi bzhi gtsigs shing khro gnyer bsdus pa/ smin ma dang smra ra dmar ser gyen du 'bar ba/ dbu skra kham nag gyen du brdzes pa/ sbrul sngo nag lto ser gyis spras shing thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan can/ phyag g.yas kyi dang po na rdo rje rgya gram/ gnyis pas rdo rje rtse lnga/ gsum pa na rdo rje lcags kyu/ g.yon gyi dang pos rdo rje'i dbyug to// gnyis pas rdo rje'i zhags pa/ gsum pas rdo rje sdigs mdzub mdzad cing de thams cad gyen du bsgrengs pa/ thod pa skam po'i phreng bas se ral khar byas pa/ yan lag thams cad sbrul gyis brgyan cing stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ zhabs gnyis bsgrad pa'i stabs kyis padma dang nyi ma'i steng na sku las skyes pa'i ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par gyur/ zhes brjod/ spro na/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas khro bo sme ba brtsegs pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ yan lag lhag ma rnams mi dgos/ rang nyid lha sku snang la rang bzhin med pa la dmigs pa rtse gcig tu gtad la/ sngags 'di bzlas so// oṃ bhūrkuṃ ma hā prā ṇā ya bhūrtsi bhūrki bi ma le u tsuṣma ma hā kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ bhūrkuṃ ri li shu tharsha hurshi bi ma le u tsuṣma ma hā kro dhā hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes ci nus bzlas mthar/

bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang mthun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab bo// bdag bskyed rkyang pa yin na 'di yan gyis chog mdun bskyed ni/ bum pa/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba zhabs zhum pa/ lto ba ldir ba/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyangs pa/ lha rdzas kyi na bzas mgul pa dkris pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud thams cad kyis yongs su gang ba'i nang du hūm̐ mthing nag las khro bo sme ba brtsegs pa sku mdog dud kha zhes pa nas/ oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ'i bar gong bdag bskyed ltar bya/ spro na/ ma lus sems can sogs shlo ka gsum gyis spyan drang*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ oṃ u tsuṣma kro dhā arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ de bzhin du sbyar/ pā dyaṃ nas/ shabda'i bar rol chen dang bcas pas mchod/ 'jigs byed sme ba brtsegs pa'i sku// rig sngags sgra yis bdud 'dul gsung*// de nyid gnyis med rab rtogs thugs// khro bo'i rgyal po khyod la bstod// ces sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa 'dis bstod/ rang gi thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la 'khril nas song bas mdun bskyed kyi lha'i thugs kar phog pas ba spu'i bu ga nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung bas bum pa gang bar gyur/ zhes brjod la sngags gnyis brgya rtsa la sogs pa bzlas/ gong ltar mchod bstod bya/ bcom ldan 'das khro bo sme ba brtsegs pas bdag dang slob ma thams cad kyi grib dang mi gtsang ba thams cad 'khrud pa'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ zhes 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ gtor ma rnams chu gtsang gis sbyang*/ gtor ma dang po/ oṃ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā bas sbyang*/

stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum/ oṃ u tsuṣma kro dhā oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ btags pa lan gsum gyis phul/ mchod bstod 'dod don gsol ba gdab pa gong ltar dang*/ gtor ma gnyis pa bsang sbyang gong ltar bya/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas rgyal po bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes spyan drang*/ padma ka mā la ya st+waṃ gyis gdan 'bul/ tsa turma hā rā dza sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum/ mtshan sngags kyi mthar arghaṃ nas shabda'i bar btags pas mchod/ zab cing rgya che gzigs pa po sogs kyi mthar/ rgyal chen sde bzhi 'khor bcas rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes sogs kyis phrin las bcol/ gtor ma gsum pa bsang sbyang byin brlab/ oṃ da sha dika lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra ā karṣa ya dzaḥs spyan drang*/ sngags la oṃ a kā ro btags pa gsum gyis phul/ 'jig rten skyong ba chen po rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la nas/ shog gi bar phrin las bcol/ bum pa'i lha la mchod bstod gong ltar byas/ yig brgya lan gsum/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*/ sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ dung chos kyi mchod yon phul ba'i rkyen gyis bum nang gi lha zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chu nus ldan du gyur/ zhes brjod cing gzungs thag bsdu'o// rjes gnang ni/ slob ma rnams khrus byas gral la 'khod khrus dang 'brel bar byed na 'og nas 'byung ba'i cho ga ltar tshang bar bya/ rjes gnang rkyang pa la mi dgos pas/ pa dang me tog bkye bsdu la sogs grub nas/ 'o/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phangs thob par bya/

de'i ched du rjes su gnang ba zab mo gsan la don nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pa'i mos gus dang ldan pa'i sgo nas legs par gsal btab ste gsan 'tshal/ de la rang re rnams kyis rnyed par dka' ba'i dal 'byor gyi mi lus rin po che 'di lta bu zhig rnyed/ mjal bar dka' ba'i rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che mjal/ bstan pa'i snying po zab mo rdo rje theg pa'i lam zab mo nyams su blang du yod pa'i skabs 'dir dal 'byor la snying po blang ba'i phyir du/ dam pa'i chos rnam par dag pa zhig bya dgos/ de lta bu'i blo can rnams la ston pas chos kyi rnam grangs du ma zhig gsungs pa'i nang nas mchog tu gyur pa gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa yin/ de la rgyud sde'i dbye sgo bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig yod pa las/ 'dir rgyud sde bzhir dbye ba'i nang nas rig sngags 'chang ba'i sde snod thams cad kyi rtsa ba lta bur gyur pa bya ba'i rgyud yin/ de la bya ba spyi'i rgyud dang so so'i rgyud gnyis las 'dir bya ba spyi'i rgyud yin/ de la dpung bzang*/ legs grub/ bsam gtan phyi ma/ gsang ba spyi rgyud bzhi las/ 'dir kri ya dpung pa bzang po dang*/ legs grub las/ phyi rol phag la sogs pa dang*// gzhan yang dag gis mi gtsang yang*// khro bo 'chol ba'i gsang sngags kyis// de tshe bsrung bar bya bar bshad// ces pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas/ rje btsun sa skya pa chen pos nye bar bkral ba gnas skabs su dam tshig nyams pa dang*/ 'khon grib mi gtsang ba thams cad nye bar zhi ba dang*/ mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya ba'i phyir du/ khro bo'i rgyal po sme ba brtsegs pa dud kha zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i rjes su gnang ba sgrub pa la sngon du 'gro ba slob dpon gyi bya ba dang*/ dngos gzhi slob ma la bya ba gnyis yod pa las/ dang po slob dpon gyis bgyi bar 'os pa thams cad legs par grub nas gnyis pa slob ma rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa la/

maṇḍal phul zhing gsol ba gdab pa/ rgyud dag par bya ba rnams su yod pa las/ thog mar slob dpon la khro bo'i rgyal po dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus sems bskyed dang ldan pa'i sgo nas rjes gnang zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal zhig 'bul bar zhu/ de ltar maṇḍal phul nas snyims pa me tog dang bcas thal mo sbyar nas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar du mdzad par zhu/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang*/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams dang*/ slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas sems can thams cad 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las bsgral zhing rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'god pa'i phyir du/ khro bo'i rgyal po sme ba brtsegs pa yi dam du stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab nas rgyud dag pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i khro bo sme ba brtsegs pa la gzhan yang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pas bskor ba mngon sum lta bur bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar khyed rang rnams kyis tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad stobs bzhi tshang ba'i sgo nas tshul bzhin du bshags par bgyi'o snyam pa la sogs pas yan lag bdun pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum nas sangs rgyas 'grub par shog gi bar/ zhes pa rnams sngon 'gro yin/ dngos gzhi la thog mar sku'i rjes gnang gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ khyed rang rnams tha mal par gsal ba'i spyi bor padma dang nyi ma'i steng du khro bo sme ba brtsegs pa sku mdog dud kha/ zhes pa nas/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ zhes pa'i bar mngon rtogs bzhin brjod/ de'i thugs kar hūm̐ mthing nag 'od 'bar ba de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa rnams spyan drangs/

sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal bsal/ khro bo'i sku la thim/ de khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas thim pas lus thams cad gdos bcas sha khrag rus pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa bsregs shing sbyangs/ sems khro bo'i rgyal po sme ba brtsegs pa sku mdog dud kha zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i skur gsal lam mer gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nyid brtan par bya ba'i slad du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sangs rgyas kun la rdor 'chang gis// dbang bskur bzhin du 'gro ba rnams// rgyal zhing yon tan 'byung ba'i gnas// de bzhin bdag la'ang gnang bar zhu// zhes gsol ba lan gsum btab cing*/ slob dpon gyis bdag gi slob ma 'di'i lus ngag yid gsum la sku gsung thugs kyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab cing bum pa spyi bor bzhag nas dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po yis// khams gsum pa yis phyag byas pa// sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi// gsang gsum gnas byung sbyin par bya// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes dang*/ oṃ bhūrkuṃ sogs kyi mthar/ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes btags la bum pa mgor bzhag bum chu blud/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur bas lus gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ spyi bor mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan pa'i mos pa mdzod/ des sku'i rjes su gnang ba thob/ lus kyi bar chad nyams grib thams cad zhi bar byas/ khro bo'i rgyal po'i sku sgom pa la dbang ba yin no// gsung gi rjes gnang gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon khro bo'i rgyal por gsal ba'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ yig dud kha'i mthar sngags phreng gis bskor ba las sngags phreng gnyis pa byung*/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas thon/ khyed rang rnams khro bor gsal ba'i zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ yig gi mthar g.yas skor du 'khod par mos pas/

sngags 'di gnyis kyi rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ oṃ bhūrkuṃ sogs/ de ltar bzlas pas dang pos rgyud byin gyis brlabs/ gnyis pas dbyer med du byas/ gsum pas brtan par byas par mos la slob dpon la drin lan gyis me tog gtor nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag gis bzung lags kyi// bcom ldan bdag la 'go bar mdzod// sngags kyi dngos grub sogs/ zhes gsol ba btab pas slob dpon gyis kyang me tog gi phreng ba sngags su byas te khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor bzhag cing byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis// bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis rlobs// sngags kyi dngos grub thob par shog /lan gsum/ rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyi rgyud la bcom ldan 'das khro rgyal sme ba brtsegs pa'i gsang sngags kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa 'jug par gyur cig des gsung gi rjes su gnang ba thob/ ngag gi bar chad nyams grib thams cad zhi bar byas/ khro bo'i rgyal po'i gsung bzlas brjod byed pa la dbang ba yin no// thugs kyi rjes gnang gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon dang khyed rang rnams lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer 'phros pa/ snod bcud thams cad la phog de 'od du zhu/ bla ma yi dam la thim/ de yang 'od du zhu nas khyed rang rnams la thim/ de yang snying ga'i yig 'bru rnams la thim/ yig 'bru rnams 'od du zhu hūm̐ la thim/ hūm̐ yang zhabs kyu la thim/ zhabs kyu khog pa la/ khog pa mgo bo la/ mgo bo zla tshes la/ zla tshes thig le la/ thig le nā da la/ nā da yang je phrar gyur nas mi dmigs pa stong pa'i ngang las/ sang nge ye rer mnyam par 'jog par zhu/ slar de'i rang nas lha sku snang la rang bzhin med par snang stong ngam gsal stong ngam bde stong zung 'jug gi ngang du mnyam par 'jog par zhu/

des thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba thob/ sems kyi bar chad nyams grib thams cad zhi bar byas/ khro bo'i rgyal po'i thugs rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes sgom pa la dbang ba yin/ zhes brjod/ skabs 'dir sa skya paṇḍi tas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs las tshogs dang bcas pa'i lung bklag des rjes gnang gi dngos gzhi legs par grub nas gnas skabs de dag tu khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa la bsrung sdom tshul bzhin du 'dzin par bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs/ rjes gnang thob pa'i gtang rag tu maṇḍal zhig 'bul bar zhu/ zhes 'bul du gzhug de ltar maṇḍal du ma zad/ lus longs spyod kyang 'bul na cha shas nas longs spyad du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ deng nas brtsams te sogs brjod/ de rnams kyis khro bo sme ba brtsegs pa dud kha sa skya paṇḍi ta nas brgyud pa'i rjes su gnang ba legs par thob pas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzad par zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs brjod/ khrus chog ni/ nad pa'am slob ma la rjes gnang dang 'brel bar byed na/ cho ga 'di rnams gang la bya ba'i bsgrub bya'i mdun du sbyong ba'i yo byad rnams bshams la chu gtsang gis bran/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ rin po che'i snod yangs par gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur/ zhes brjod/ mchod g.yog gis theb kyu dang changs bu re mnyam du bzung*/ bsgrub bya la g.yas skor du bskor zhing*/ slob dpon gyis g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang bcas/ na maḥs manta buddhā nāṃ/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sambha ra sambha ra hūm̐/ oṃ e ho shuddhe shuddhe/ baṃ ho shuddhe shuddhe/ raṃ ho shuddhe shuddhe/ e baṃ raṃ shuddhe shuddhe/ a a a swā hā/ zhes se gol dang bcas pas snod che ba'i nang du glud bzhag pa'i mthar bcug pa nyer gcig gi bar du bya/

de nas nad pa'am slob ma'i rkang lag gi srin mdzub bzhi la skud pa nag por bcings pa/ slob dpon gyis rdor dril 'dzin pas/ khyed rang rnams dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon khro bo'i rgyal po smre ba brtsegs par gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pa'i sna la/ de 'dra ba'i khro bo lcags kyu zhags pa thogs pa dpag tu med pa 'phros pas/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i nyams grib dang*/ mi gtsang ba'i gdon bgegs bar du gcod pa thams cad snying ga nas lcags kyus bzung*/ mgrin pa nas zhags pas bcings/ phyogs mtshams steng 'og thams cad nas bkug khyed rang rnams kyi srin lag bzhi la bcings pa'i skud pa nag po de nyid la sib sib thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ slar yang khro bo de dag khyed rang rnams kyi lus kyi nang nas mar song ste/ lus kyi nang na gnas pa'i nad rims gdon bgegs sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad kyang rang dbang med par lus kyi kha sna dang mig la sogs pa nas phyir thon te/ srin lag bzhi la bcings pa'i skud pa sogs rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi= chos kyi= dge 'dun gyi= gsang sngags dang rig sngags kyi rgyal po khro bo rnams kyi= gzungs sngags kyi rgyal mo khro mo rnams kyi= khyad par du yang khro bo'i rgyal po sme ba brtsegs pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dpal mgon dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams kyi= bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis/ rdo rje slob ma'am sbyin pa'i bdag po 'di rnams la gnod par byed pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib mi gtsang ba thams cad dang*/ mdor na mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad rang rang so so'i yan lag bzhi la bcings pa'i zhags pa nag po 'di nyid la skad cig thang cig yud tsam la thim par gyur cig

ṭā ki hūm̐ dzaḥ lan gsum/ khyed rnams kyi yan lag la bcings pa'i zhags pa nag po de nyid nad gdon sdig sgrib sogs mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad 'dus pa'i zhags pa nag po re rer gyur pa de nyid slob dpon khro bor gsal bas kham̐ las skyes pa'i ral gri'i so la ye shes kyi me dang chus ngar blud pas dum bur gcad pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces dang*/ oṃ bhūrkuṃ sogs sngags gnyis brjod/ ral gri de mar me'i dbal dang*/ ting phor gyi chur bcug pa des skud pa dum bur bcad/ bsgrub bya la phyir lan gsum bskor nas ngar glud mthar bzhag rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad zhags pa'i dum bu ngar glud changs bu dang bcas pa la thim/ zhes brjod/ bkru ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ mdun bskyed kyi bum pa'i nang du khro bo sme ba brtsegs pa dngos su bzhugs pa'i sku'i cha shas las byung ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho des khyed rang rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum bkrus pa tsam gyis nad gdon sdig sgrib mi gtsang ba thams cad dud khu'am rnag khrag gi rnam par nu ru ru dag song snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ byas la sngags gnyis kyi mjug tu/ rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyi nad thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ gdon thams cad= rims thams cad= nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad= 'khon grib thams cad= rme grib thams cad= dmar grib thams cad= yugs grib thams cad= zas grib thams cad= gos grib thams cad= ro grib thams cad= gdon grib thams cad= bdud kyi zhags pa thams cad= gshin rje'i pho nya thams cad= bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad= zhes brjod cing bum chus bkru'o// byabs pa ni/ de ltar bkrus pas ma dag pa'i nad gdon lhag ma de dag rma bya'i sgro 'di'i dbus su hūm̐ yig dud kha las 'od zer 'phros pas nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad sman pa mkhas pas skyugs sman btang ba ltar/

glud de'i mgor nag rgyang rgyang skyugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ byas la khar chu bzung rma bya'i sgros byab cing*/ rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyi nad gdon thams cad a pa nā ya swā hā/ zhes sogs brjod la/ kha nang gi chu glud kyi steng du blug rol mo dang hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya dang bcas/ ting nge 'dzin gyi nga rgyal brtan pos/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang zhes pa nas/ byin rlabs kyis zhes pa'i bar gong ltar las/ deng 'dir rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i gdon bgegs log par 'dren pa thams cad glud gtor 'dis tshims par gyis la sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig gang dag mi 'gro ba de dag la dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes las byung ba'i khro bo'i rdo rje ye shes kyi me 'bar zhing kun tu 'bar ba 'dis mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par 'gyur ba gdon mi za'o// zhes dang rol mo drag tu bya/ gu gul gyis bdug yungs kar gyis brabs te bgegs dang bral bar bsam/ slar mi 'jug pa bya ba'i phyir bsrung bar bya ba ni/ khyed rang rnams dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ de ltar gdon bgegs rnams rgyang ring du bskrad nas/ slar mi 'jug par bya ba'i phyir du slob dpon gyis khyed rnams kyi spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rje bzhag pa las/ gcig las gnyis/ gnyis las gsum sogs chad de lus la rdo rje'i go bgos pa'i mos pa mdzod/ byas la/ rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi nad thams cad rakṣa rakṣa/ zhes sogs brjod/ lus kyi spyi gtsug dpung pa gnyis/ mdun rgyab gnyis/ pus mo gnyis rnams su rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag mthar spyi bor bzung nas/ rgyal ba sras bcas bden pa'i byin rlabs dang*// khro rgyal sme ba brtsegs pa'i nus mthu yis// 'gro ba 'di la bdag gis bsrungs zin gyis// 'di la sus kyang gnod pa ma byed cig

/oṃ badzra rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes dang shis pa brjod pa rgyas par bya'o// gsum pa rjes ni/ mchod pa rnams kha gso/ bsang sbyang byin gyis brlab/ oṃ u tsuṣma kro dhā re re'i mgor sbyar ba'i arghaṃ nas shabda'i bar dang*/ 'jigs byed sme ba brtsegs pa'i sku// zhes sogs kyi bstod/ 'dod don la gsol ba gdab/ yig brgya lan gsum gyis lhag chad kha bskang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /khro bo'i rgyal po 'grub gyur nas// zhes sogs smon lam shis brjod rgyas par bya'o// lo chen rin chen grags pas legs bkral shing*// sa skya'i rje btsun mchog la bka' babs pa'i// sme brtsegs bdag mdun rjes gnang khrus chog bcas// gsal bar bkod 'dis 'gro kun dge gyur cig /ces sme ba brtsegs pa dud kha'i rjes gnang dang khrus chog bya tshul gsal bar bkod pa mthong bas don grub ces bya ba 'di ni/ sngon chad 'di'i phyag len gyi yi ge gsal bar mi 'dug pas/ sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa'i rtsa ba'i sgrub thabs dang yig rnying gi tho rje btsun bsod nams lhun grub pa dang*/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan gyis mdzad pa'i bum chog rnams la gzhi brten/ rje bla ma'i phyag len nyams pa med pa rnams kyis brgyan te/ rang bzo'i dri mas ma gos par bka' drin gzhal med drin chen rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub kyi zhabs pad yun ring du brten cing gsung gi bdud rtsis skal pa bzang por gyur pa'i bka' 'bangs kyi tha chung bya bral ba kun dga' lhun grub kyis dben gnas smon dga' bsam gtan gling gi khang bur sug bris su btab pa 'dis rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig /shu bhaṃ// ༈ /khro bo'i rgyal po sme ba brtsegs pa dud kha'i sgo nas grib mdos bkru byabs srung gsum dang bcas pa bya tshul mkhyen rab rje'i snag dbon rje btsun bsod nams lhun grub kyis mdzad pa bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti/

'dir khro bo'i rgyal po sme ba brtsegs pa'i sgo nas nad pa lta bu la khrus chog glud dang bcas pa byed dgos byung na slob dpon khro bo'i rgyal po rjes gnang thob cing mtshan nyid dang ldan pas 'di ltar bya'o// dang po 'di la dgos pa'i yo byad bum pa/ khrus long*/ glud zan/ grib bdag gi glud sogs dgos pa ma tshang ba med pa/ mdun du mchod stegs gtor ma dang bcas pa bla ma'i phyag len ma 'phyugs par bsham/ de nas slob dpon gyis mchod pa byin gyis brlab/ skyabs 'gro nas bdag bskyed bzlas pa'i bar gzhung bzhin bya/ mdun bskyed bum pa la byed pas na/ bum pa a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba lto ba ldir ba/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel zhing mchu 'phyangs pa/ lha'i gos kyis mgul pa dkris pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba'i dbus su pam̐ las padma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ dud kha de las 'od zer 'phros/ sbyin bdag gis gtsor byas pa'i sems can thams cad la phog sems can gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ khyad par du 'di zhes bya ba'i nad gdon sdig sgrib mi gtsang ba'i grib dang bcas pa mi mthun phyogs thams cad sbyangs/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las khro bo'i rgyal po sme ba brtsegs pa sku mdog dud kha zhal gsum phyag drug ces pa nas/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i skur gyur/ zhes pa'i bar brjod/ ye shes pa dgug gzhug 'di la mi dgos/ de nas mchod pa byin rlabs bya/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho sogs nas/ mtshan sngags sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod shabda'i bar gyis mchod/ bstod pa rgyas bsdus ci rigs bya/ de nas bdag gi zhal nas sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la 'khril te song bas mdun bskyed kyi lha yi thugs kar phog

lha'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bas che ge mo'i nad gdon sdig sgrib mi gtsang ba'i grib la sogs pa 'khrud pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ zhes brjod la/ gzungs thag nas bzung la sngags lnga brgya sogs bzlas/ sarba ta thā ga

khrus sngags/ ta sogs bzlas shing gzungs thag bsdu/ mchod bstod byas nas bum pa'i lha gshegs gsol mi byed par/ khro bo'i rgyal pos slob mas gtsor byas sems can thams cad kyi mi gtsang ba thams cad 'khrud pa'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ gtor ma a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du ye shes kyi ka pā la phyi dkar la nang dmar ba yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ zhes dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ lan gsum gyis bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par bsam/ rtsa sngags la a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyis bum nang gi lha la phul/ mchod bstod dang*/ mchod sbyin gtor ma sogs phrin las bcol ba gzhung bzhin bya'o// rjes gnang dngos la slob ma rnams mdun du bos la/ sngon 'gro'i chos bshad ci rigs byas nas/ dngos gzhi la sngon du 'gro ba bkru byabs srung gsum yod pa las/ dang po la dmigs pa 'di bzhin du gyis shig mdun bskyed pa'i nang du khro bo'i rgyal po sme ba brtsegs pa dngos su bzhugs pa de'i sku'i cha shas las gyur ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho de yis khyed rang rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum bkrus pa tsam gyis nad gdon sdig sgrib mi gtsang ba thams cad dud khu'am rnag khrag gi rnam pas nu ru ru dag song snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod byas la/ sngags sngon du 'gro bas/ rdo rje slob ma 'di'i nad thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ gdon thams cad= rims thams cad= nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad= mkhon grib thams cad= bdud kyi zhags pa thams cad= gshin rje'i pho nya thams cad= bgegs dang log par 'dren pa thams cad= ces brjod cing bum chus bkru'o// gnyis pa de ltar bkrus pas ma dag pa'i nad gdon lhag ma de dag rma bya'i sgro la sogs pas byabs pa'i rdzas bdun dang ldan pa rnams kyis glud de'i mgo la sngar gyi shāntiṃ gi tshab tu a pa na ya brjod cing byabs nas mjug tu/

de ltar byas pas khyed rang rnams kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad skyugs sman btang ba ltar glud de'i mgo la nag rgyang rgyang skyug pa'i mos pa mdzod byas/ gong du bum chu khar bzung ba de skyug tu gzhug de nas glud la brdzongs dang bgegs bskrad pa ni/ rnga rdung zhing 'di skad do/ hūm̐/ nga ni khro rgyal sme ba brtsegs// dregs 'joms rgyal po he ru ka /snang srid lha 'dre thams cad dang*// grib bdag thams cad nga la nyon// nyi ma nub phyogs pha gi na// mun pa nag po'i gting rum na// grib mkhan nag po'i nang shed na// grib bdag nag po chen po khyod// sku mdog nag la mun pa'i mdog /chibs su grib rta nag po chibs// grib gos nag po rgyab la gyon// grib dar nag po lag na 'phyar// grib 'phru nag po mgo la btsugs// grib bya nag po klad na lding*// grib khyi nag po rgyab tu khrid// grib bdag chen po grib longs shig /de yi bka' nyan las byed pa// 'dod chags bya nag mgo bo can// zhe sdang sbrul nag mgo bo can// gti mug phag nag mgo bo can// ma rig sbal nag mgo bo can// khyod ni grib kyi bdag po yin// bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag la// zas grib gos grib nor gyi grib// de 'dra'i grib rnams sangs gyur cig /mdze grib btsog grib yugs sa'i grib// de 'dra'i grib rnams sangs gyur cig /dmar grib dme grib gdon gyi grib// de 'dra'i grib rnams= lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin grib// de 'dra'i grib rnams= rgyal po 'byung po 'gong po'i grib// de 'dra'i grib rnams= the'u rang dri za gnod byed bgegs// de 'dra'i grib rnams= nyon mongs dug lnga las kyi grib// de 'dra'i grib rnams= sngar gyi khas blangs nyams chags grib// de 'dra'i grib rnams= grib bdag chen po grib sol cig /grib bdag khyod la brdzongs btab bo// 'bru srid 'bru nag tshig phye la// grib gtor nag po'i dam rdzas dang*// ngar mi lan chags changs bu dang*// grib yon cha ma cho dgu 'di// grib bdag khyod la brdzongs btab bo// grib bdag chen po grib sol cig

/kyai grib bdag khyod la lam bstan pa// nyi ma nub phyogs pha gi na// mun pa nag po'i klong dkyil na// grib yul mun pa nag re skyid// grib mkhar nag po rdzong re btsan// grib mkhar nag po'i gting rum du// grib bdag chen po der song zhig /'di na khyod kyi gnas ma mchis// grib nad sol la der song zhig /grib bdag rang rang gnas su gshegs// kye rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po yi// mgo nas sprin ltar gtibs pa de// grib bdag rgyal po khyod la byol// lce nas rlung bzhin g.yo ba de// grib bdag rgyal po khyod la byol// snying nad me ltar 'bar ba de// grib bdag rgyal po khyod la byol// mchin nad nya ltar 'phar ba de// grib bdag rgyal po= nang cha bu dgu na ba de// grib bdag rgyal po= mkhal nad chu ltar 'khrugs pa de// grib bdag rgyal po= sna nad zhang zhom na ba de// grib bdag rgyal po= phung po lnga po na ba de// grib bdag rgyal po= ma mo phur bu na ba de// grib bdag rgyal po= mig dang so la na ba de// grib bdag rgyal po khyod la byol// rgyu sbyor yon bdag 'khor bcas la// bcings pa yod na bkrol du gsol// mnan pa yod na bteg tu gsol// slob ma'i lus ngag yid gsum la// gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i bgegs// 'dre gdon rigs gyur thams cad rnams// nga yi bka' las 'da' gyur na// mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas shing*// lus kyang dum bur gtubs 'gyur phyir// glud bdag rnams kyis glud 'di khyer// hūm̐ grib bdag shar gyi phyogs su song*// shar phyogs dri za'i phyogs su song*// dri za'i gdon rnams sangs gyur cig /grib bdag lho yi phyogs su song*// lho phyogs gshin rje'i phyogs= gshin rje'i gdon rnams sangs= grib bdag nub kyi phyogs su= nub phyogs klu yi phyogs= klu yi gdon rnams sangs= grib bdag byang gi phyogs su=

byang phyogs gnod sbyin yul du= gnod sbyin grib rnams sangs gyur cig /phyogs bzhi dang ni mtshams brgyad dang*// steng 'og gdon rnams sangs gyur cig /phyogs mtshams gang na gnas pa'i gdon// grib bdag chen po rang gnas song*// da lta nyid du mi 'gro na// rdo rje 'chang chen rnal 'byor ngas// thal ba'i rdul du rlag par byed// myur ba nyid du rlag par byed// myur ba nyid du da lta song*// zhes dang*/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ ting nge 'dzin gyi nga rgyal brtan pos/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bden pa dang*// sangs rgyas kyi= chos kyi= dge 'dun gyi= gsang sngags dang rig sngags kyi rgyal po khro bo rnams kyi= gzungs sngags kyi rgyal mo khro mo rnams kyi= khyad par du yang khro bo'i rgyal po sme ba brtsegs pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyi= dpal mgon dam pa chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis/ deng 'dir rdo rje slob ma 'di'i lus ngag yid gsum la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i gdon bgegs log par 'dren pa thams cad glud 'dis tshims par gyis la sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig gal te mi 'gro na dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes las byung ba'i khro bo'i rdo rje ye shes kyi me 'bar zhing kun du rab tu 'bar ba 'dis mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par 'gyur bar gdon mi za'o// zhes brjod cing rol mo drag tu dkrol/ gu gul gyi dud pas bdug yungs kar gyis brabs te bgegs rnams rang gnas su song bar bsam/ de nas gsum pa de ltar gdon bgegs rnams rgyang ring du bskrad nas slar mi 'jug par bya ba'i phyir du slob dpon gyis khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rje bzhag pa las/

gcig las gnyis/ gnyis las gsum chad nas lus la rdo rje'i go bsgos pa'i mos pa mdzod/ byas la sngar gyi a pa na ya'i tshab tu rakṣa rakṣa zhes brjod/ gnas nyi shu rtsa gcig tu rdo rjes reg par bsam/ mdun du sna tshogs rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag de dag gis sngon 'gro'i bya ba song nas/ rjes gnang dngos la dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod byas la/ swa bhā was sbyangs nas/ sku'i rjes gnang lus la bskur ba/ gsung gi rjes gnang ngag la bskur ba/ thugs kyi rjes gnang sems la bskur ba/ spyi bor gtor ma'i bka' bsgo/ mjug dam tshig khas blang*/ maṇḍal/ lus longs spyod 'bul ba rnams gzhung bzhin bya'o// zhes pa 'di ni sngon chad yig cha kha gsal ba zhig mi 'dug pas/ rjes 'jug gi slob ma las dang po pa rnams nyams su blang bde ba'i phyir mkhyen rab rdo rje 'chang yab sras kyi gsung las skyes pa zhwa lu'i bya bral ba bsod nams lhun grub kyis bsam pa bzang pos kun nas bslangs te bris pa'o// ༈ /bsgrub bya'i nad gdon nyams grib sel bar 'dod pas/ grib glud bsgrub bya'i khrus chu dang dri zan las byas pa lag len ltar bsham/ zur du changs bu dang theb kyu nyer gcig ting lo dang changs bu gsum re/ bsgrub bya'i grangs dang mnyam pa'i skud pa nag po rdo rje'i mdud pa byas pa sogs bsham/ rjes gnang gi sngon 'gro khrus grub pa'i skabs su gong du bshams pa'i changs bu re dang theb kyu re sbrags pa bskor ba bzhag pa chus bran la/ rin po che'i snod yangs pa gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur/ zhes brjod cing las kyi rdo rjes bsgrub bya la g.yas skor du bskor zhing*/ slob dpon gyis g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang bcas/ na maḥs manta buddha nāṃ/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sambha ra sambha ra hūm̐/ oṃ e ho shuddhe shuddhe/ baṃ ho shuddhe shuddhe/

raṃ ho shuddhe shuddhe/ e baṃ raṃ shuddhe shuddhe a a a swā hā/ se gol dang bcas pas ngar glud kyi mthar bzhag pa nyer gcig dang*/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams la bar du gcod par rtsom pa'i gdon bgegs gang yin pa thams cad gtor ma 'dis tshims par gyis shig zhi drag gis sbyong ba khro bo spyan drangs pa sogs byas nas/ sngar gyi skud pa rkang lag gi srin mdzub bzhi la bcing*/ nad pa lta bu lus tsho mi thub pa la g.yon kho na'ang rung*/ slob dpon gyis/ khyed rang rnams dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon khro bo'i rgyal po sme ba brtsegs par gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas/ de'i sna la khro bo de 'dra ba lcags kyu dang zhags pa thogs pa dpag tu med par spros te/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i nyams grib dang mi gtsang ba'i gdon bgegs bar du gcod pa thams cad kyi snying ga nas lcags kyu bkug mgrin pa nas zhags pas bcings/ phyogs mtshams steng 'og thams cad nas bkug khyed rang rnams kyi yan lag bzhi la bcings pa'i skud pa nag po de nyid la sib sib thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ slar yang slob dpon khro bor gsal bas kham̐ las skyes pa'i ral gri so ma me dang chur bcug ste ngar btags pa de nyid kyis dum bur gcad pa'i mos pa mdzod ces dang*/ bhūrkuṃ sogs sngags gnyis brjod/ ral gri de mar me'i dbal dang ting phor gyi chur bcug ste ngar blud pas gcod cing lag pa g.yon pas bzung nas bsgrub bya la phyir lan gsum bskor nas ngar glud kyi mthar bzhag rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad zhags pa nag po ngar glud changs bu theb kyu ting lo dang bcas pa la thim par gyur cig ces pa 'di rnams drag po'i sbyong ba'o// de 'dra ba lan gsum mam lnga'am bdun byas na nad pa la nges pa phan no// de nas byabs pa dang glud la brdzongs pas lam bstan byas nas bden bdar drag rol sogs dang*/

slar bsrung ba byas nas spyi bor rdo rje bzhag khro bo'i sngags gnyis tshar gcig mthar/ rgyal ba sras bcas bden pa'i byin rlabs dang*// khro rgyal sme ba brtsegs pa'i nus mthu yis// 'gro ba 'di la bdag gis bsrungs zin gyis// 'di la sus kyang gnod pa ma byed cig /oṃ badzra rakṣa sogs dang*/ bkra shis bya'o// 'di'i lung phyag len bcas thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rje bsod nams lhun grub/ ngag dbang mchog legs rdo rje/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ drin can rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ des bdag lhun grub la'o// shu bhaṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
